how-do-you-say.text: ___ को हिंदी में क्या कहते हैं?
how-do-you-say.rom: ___ ko hindee men kyaa kahte hain?

notes: माफ़ कीजिए? with a rising voice means "sorry, what was that?". फिर से means "again".
धीरे बोलिए ("speak slowly") is polite as it is: the -इए ending already says please.
मुझे समझ नहीं आया ("to me understanding did not come") is how Hindi says I don't understand.
